limitations: Installed data tables have encrypted/packed headers. Matching decrypted file size plus 48 bytes is not proof of equivalence.
EquipmentType is an AI classification and misclassifies several primaries/special secondaries; selection uses LoadoutItemType instead.

The 20 shootable rows means identified Projectile/Beam/Arc/Spray components. Six named melee rows and one unnamed row remain outside that identified firing scope; the unnamed row has MeleeAttackComponent.
Projectile type 0 is a base component value, not the actual shot type. Customization/attachment resolution is required at runtime.
Beam, spray and entity projectile collision mechanisms are not implemented by the native slot flag writer. Catalog completeness does not imply these weapons self-hit.
Internal or unreleased reference entries can be present. Human labels do not prove current availability. Unknown future table fingerprints require a reviewed catalog regeneration.
Shotgun and multishot projectile exclusion remains a separate earlier filter. P-11 stays in its unchanged original addon.
